selection_rules.missing_companies: 60 unique current US companies; exactly 15 per main classification class; FY 2012–2025; one primary missing period per company balanced over available period-end years, then SHA-256(seed|scope|...); add at most one additional missing period for that selected company
selection_rules.period_end_year_scope: calendar year of local Q4 end; available years are recorded in strata and may include 2026 where FY 2025 ends in 2026
selection_rules.control_periods: 60 unique tickers with one Q4 period each; answer-set rows whose key index in sorted unique keys has mod 8 in {4,5,6,7}; deterministic SHA-256(seed|control-company|ticker) ordering; exclude every ticker in the frozen stage-two control sample
selection_rules.control_value_firewall: selection stores no answer-set EPS, stored value, net income, filing accession, or filing date; answer-set values are read only by the post-extraction comparison command
selection_rules.local_eligibility: period must match one SEC-sourced quarterly row with fq=4 and one SEC-sourced annual period for the same FY; no financials file is modified
selection_rules.stage2_control_exclusion: all 60 unique ticker keys in docs/report/sec-q4-eps-stage2/sample.json are excluded before control selection
